
    function pickUniqueNames(list, count, excludedName = '') {
      const seen = new Set(excludedName ? [excludedName] : []);
      const output = [];
      for (const item of shuffle(list)) {
        if (!item || !item.name || !item.image || seen.has(item.name)) continue;
        seen.add(item.name);
        output.push(item);
        if (output.length === count) break;
      }
      return output;
    }

    function pickFogPoint(previous = null) {
      const candidates = previous
        ? FOG_POINTS.filter((point) => Math.hypot(point.x - previous.x, point.y - previous.y) >= 40)
        : FOG_POINTS;
      const source = candidates.length ? candidates : FOG_POINTS.filter((point) => point !== previous);
      return source[Math.floor(Math.random() * source.length)];
    }

    function setFogPoint(point, animate = false) {
      currentFogPoint = point;
      root.style.setProperty('--fog-x', point.x + '%');
      root.style.setProperty('--fog-y', point.y + '%');
      if (animate) {
        $('scope').classList.remove('moving');
        void $('scope').offsetWidth;
        $('scope').classList.add('moving');
        setTimeout(() => $('scope').classList.remove('moving'), 500);
      }
    }

    function moveFogPoint() {
      setFogPoint(pickFogPoint(currentFogPoint), true);
      $('positionTip').textContent = '侦察点已转移';
      setTimeout(() => { if (!answered) $('positionTip').textContent = '侦察位置已锁定'; }, 850);
    }

    function applyVisual(element, question) {
      element.style.backgroundImage = `url("${question.image}")`;
      element.style.backgroundSize = element.id === 'backdrop' ? 'cover' : 'contain';
      element.style.backgroundPosition = 'center';
    }

    function updateLoading(progress, text) {
      $('loadingBar').style.width = Math.max(12, Math.min(100, progress)) + '%';
      if (text) $('loadingCopy').textContent = text;
    }

    function preloadImage(url) {
      return new Promise((resolve) => {
        const image = new Image();
        image.onload = () => resolve(true);
        image.onerror = () => resolve(false);
        image.src = url;
      });
    }

    async function boot() {
      try {
        updateLoading(22, '正在读取英雄档案...');
        const response = await fetch('./assets/heroes.json?v=' + Date.now());
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error('英雄清单加载失败');
        const data = await response.json();
        pool = data.filter((item) => item && item.id && item.name && item.image);
        const uniqueNames = new Set(pool.map((item) => item.name));
        if (uniqueNames.size < GAME_SIZE) throw new Error('可用英雄不足');

        $('poolSize').textContent = uniqueNames.size;
        $('bestScore').textContent = Number(localStorage.getItem('dotaFogBest') || 0).toLocaleString();
        $('challengeNo').textContent = 'DAILY CHALLENGE · #' + String(dailyNumber()).padStart(3, '0');

        updateLoading(45, '正在随机本局英雄...');
        rounds = pickUniqueNames(pool, GAME_SIZE);
        const preloadResults = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < rounds.length; i++) {
          preloadResults.push(await preloadImage(rounds[i].image));
          updateLoading(45 + ((i + 1) / rounds.length) * 48, `正在载入英雄素材 ${i + 1}/${rounds.length}...`);
        }
        if (preloadResults.every((value) => !value)) throw new Error('英雄图片全部加载失败');

        updateLoading(100, '真视校准完成');
        startSession(false);
        setTimeout(() => $('loading').classList.add('hidden'), 280);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);
        updateLoading(100, '资源加载失败，请刷新页面重试');
        $('loadingBar').style.background = '#b53b2d';
      }
